verses.text: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
verses.plain: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.

verses.text: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
verses.plain: Dear friend, do not imitate what is evil but what is good. Anyone who does good is from God; anyone who does evil has not seen God.
